name: Comics Salón & AnimeSHOW
blurb: Slovakia's largest pop-culture festival in Bratislava: the Comics Salón comic con each September and the AnimeSHOW anime con each March, both at DK Ružinov.
notes: One brand, two shows a year at the same venue (DK Ružinov, Bratislava): AnimeSHOW each spring (most recent: 27-29 Mar 2026, per the aftermovie caption) and Comics Salón each September (most recent/39th edition: 18-20 Sep 2026, per the ticket section '18.–20. septembra 2026 DK Ružinov'). Both of those already ended before the research window (must end on/after 2026-10-05), and the homepage announces no 2027 dates yet for either show (it still shows a 'Plagát ročníka 2026' / 2026 poster placeholder as 'TO BE PROVIDED'), so editions is empty; 'last' uses the more recent of the two shows, Comics Salón 2026. Organizer confirmed via web search: OZ AnimeCrew plus (a Slovak civic association, Bratislava) runs the festival. No guests pulled since no in-window edition exists.
